part.text:
Implemented Handlebars templating support:

- Added `handlebars` dependency.
- Supports `templates/*.hbs`, `templates/layouts/*.hbs`, and `templates/partials/*.hbs`.
- Uses `default.hbs` and `layouts/default.hbs` automatically when available.
- Supports frontmatter `template:` and `layout:`.
- Layouts receive `{{{body}}}`; page templates receive `{{{content}}}` and page metadata.
- Added `--templates <dir>` CLI option.
- Added template/layout/partial and error-handling Jest tests.
- Existing built-in rendering remains when no templates exist.

`npm`, `node`, `tsc`, and `pytest` are unavailable in this environment, so neither Jest nor pytest could run. Diff whitespace validation passed.
